tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /gu ru drag po'i sgrub thabs phrin las myur sgrub bzhugs so// na mo gu ru de wa ḍā kī n+yai bh+yaḥ bla ma bde gshegs 'dus pa'i sku/ /dkon mchog gsum gyi rang bzhin la/ /bdag dang 'gro drug sems can rnams/ /byang chub bar du skyabs su mchi/ /na mo thugs rje 'gro la dgongs mdzad pa'i/ /bla ma rnams la skyabs su mchi/ /rtse gcig thugs rjes byin rlob pa'i/ /yi dam lha la skyabs su mchi/ /rtsod zlog med pa'i thugs rje can/ /sangs rgyas rnams la skyabs su mchi/ /chags pa med par 'gro don mdzad/ /dam pa'i chos la skyabs su mchi/ /ma nor lam la mnga' mdzad pa'i/ /dge 'dun rnams la skyabs su mchi/ /'gro ba'i don du rang byung sku 'khrungs pa'i/ /pad+ma 'byung gnas sku la skyabs su mchi/ /nyes legs btang 'dzin dam tshig rjes gcod pa'i/ /phyi nang mkha' 'gro'i tshogs la skyabs su mchi/ /na mo brgyud pa'i rtsa ba bla ma rje/ /dngos grub 'byung ba'i yi dam lha/ /legs par byin rlob mkha' 'gro ma/ /rtsa ba gsum la skyabs su mchi/ /rtsa ba gsum gyis byin gyis rlobs/ /na mo sems bskyed 'gro ba kun don du/ /bla ma sangs rgyas bsgrubs nas kyang / /gang la gang 'dul phrin las kyi/ /'gro drug bsgral bar dam bca'o/ /lan gsum/ /rang skad cig gis gu ru drag po'i skur gyur/ /hūm̐ nga ni ye nas ngang gi khro/ /mtshams gcod khro bos nam mkha' gang / /bgegs 'dul khro bo'i rol mtshams las/ /su yang 'da' bar ma byed cig /oṃ āḥhūm̐ a tsig nir tsig na mo bha ga wa te hūm̐ hūm̐ āḥhūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa/ sarba bigh+nān gats+tsha/ rang gi snying kha nas 'od 'phros/ bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro dpa' bo'i tshogs thams cad badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro dgongs/ /nyi zla pad ma'i gdan la bzhugs/ /lus ngag yid gsum gus phyag 'tshal/ /phyi nang gsang gsum mchod pa 'bul/ /nyams chags sdig sgrib mthol zhing bshags/

/gsang sngags sgrub la rjes yi rangs/ /smin grol gsang sngags 'khor lo bskor/ /mya ngan mi 'da' bzhugs su gsol/ /snying po sems can don du bsngo/ /yang dag rdo rje don rtogs shog /bde bar gshegs pa thams cad kyi thugs rje byin rlabs bsdus nas rang gi snying khar thim/ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ a la la hoḥ sa ma ya satwaṃ byin phob cig hūm̐ chos sku mi 'gyur rdo rje yi/ /pad+ma rgyal pos 'di skad gsung / /dang po chos rnams dmigs med cing / /smra brjod bral ba rdzogs pa che/ /blo 'das chos sku mi 'gyur ba'i/ /de bzhin nyid kyi ting 'dzin bsgom/ /blo bral de'i ngang nas ni/ /sems can kun la khyab pa yi/ /brtse bas snying rje chen po bsgom/ /kun tu snang ba'i ting nge 'dzin/ /stong nyid snying rje'i ngang can de/ /'gro don dpag med byed pa la/ /rgyu'i ting 'dzin rang gi sems/ /hūm̐ gi yi ge dmar por gyur/ /e yaṃ ra suṃ keṃ raṃ bh+rūm̐/ /e las nam mkha' mtha' dbus med/ /yaṃ las rlung gi dkyil 'khor bltams/ /raṃ las rak+ta'i rgya mtshor 'khyil/ /suṃ las zhing chen sa gzhi brdal/ /keṃ las keṃ rus ri rab brtsigs/ /raṃ las bskal pa'i me dpung 'bar/ /bh+rūm̐ las dur khrod gzhal yas khang / /phyi ni thod rlon bar ni snying / /skam po nang byas rtsig pa can/ /gnam lcags gzer btab gru bzhi pa/ /sgo bzhir zhing gi rgyal mtshan 'phyar/ /tshangs pa pho mo'i ka gdung byas/ /zhing lpags thog dang bla bre bres/ /rgyu ma'i dra phyed don snying 'phyang / /phyi nang me dpung dmar nag 'bar/ /gzhal las khang pa de'i nang / /'khor lo sngon po rtsibs bzhi pa/ /mu khyud rdo rje rwa bas bskor/ /dbus su gru gsum mthing nag 'bar/ /zla gam dmar nag gsum dang bcas/ /gzhal yas khang pa'i phyi rol du/ /gser gyi 'khor lo g.yas su 'khor/ /de rtse sdig pas mtshan pa'o/ /me yi 'khor lo g.yon du 'khor/ /rtse bsnol bar du dgra bgegs 'joms/

/de rgyab rdo rje'i gur khang phub/ /phyi rol ye shes me dpung 'bar/ /dgra bgegs 'byung po thams cad bsregs/ /dbus su pad+ma maṇ+ḍal/ /ma sūr+ya maṇ+ḍal/ a tsan+d+ra maṇ+ḍal/ rāk+ṣa pā/ ti ra baṃ/ pad+ma nyi zla srin po zhing chen bsnol ba'i gdan gyi steng du/ hūm̐ yig dmar po bsam pa las/ phyogs bcur 'od 'phros sangs rgyas kyi/ /thugs dam rgyud bskul 'gro don byas/ /tshur 'dus hūm̐ la thim pa las/ /bdag nyid zil gnon pad+ma'i sku/ /dmar po me yi phreng bas brgyan/ /zhal gcig phyag gnyis spyan gsum bgrad/ /phyag g.yas rdo rje nam mkhar 'phyar/ /g.yon pa lcags sdig kha dgu bsnams/ /dbu skra snum 'bol gyen du brdzes/ /thod skam lnga yis dbu la rgyan/ /rlon pa lnga bcu'i do shal byas/ /rus pa'i rgyan drug sku la spras/ /dbu dang phyag zhabs sbrul gyis rgyan/ /glang lpags zhing chen g.yang gzhi gsol/ /stag gi lpags pa'i 'og lpags can/ /rak+ta zhag dang thal chen gyis/ /thig le zo ris tshom bur byas/ /me dpung 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs/ /de yi spyi gtsug bya khyung rgyal/ /mthing nag me yi gshog pa can/ /gnam lcags thog me'i tsha tsha 'phro/ /de steng pad+ma nyi zla'i gdan/ /rigs kyi bdag po snang mtha' yas/ /sku mdog dmar po mnyam gzhag can/ /dar dang rin chen sna tshogs brgyan/ /sku'i ngo bo mtshon gang pa/ /dpral ba'i mdzod spu'i khro gnyer steng / /gser gyi 'khor lo rtsibs bzhi'i dbus/ /'jam dpal sku mdog gser gyi mdog zhal gcig phyag gnyis dbu rgyan can/ /g.yas pas shes rab ral gri 'phyar/ /g.yon pas thugs khar sdigs mdzub mdzad/ /cung zad khro tshul 'gying bag can/ /de'i spyi bor yi ge oṃ/ /gser mdog bdag sku byin gyis rlobs/ /mgrin par pad+ma 'dab bzhi'i dbus/ /rta mgrin zhal gcig phyag gnyis dmar/ /spyi gtsug rta mgo ljang khu can/ /rta skad nam mkha'i dbyings su sgrog /g.yas pa rdo rje dbyug pa 'phyar/

/g.yon pas thugs kar sdigs mdzub mdzad/ /brkyang bskum dor stabs bzhugs pa'o/ /de'i mgrin par yi ge āḥ /dmar po bdag gsung byin gyis rlobs/ /thugs dkar gser gyi mchod rten ser/ /ri rab bang rim bum pa bre/ /chos 'khor tog dang ldan par bsgom/ /bum par phyag na rdo rje ni/ /mthing nag zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ /g.yas pa rdo rje nam mkhar 'phyar/ /g.yon pas thugs dkar sdigs mdzub mdzad/ /khro gtum drag po brjid pa'i sku/ /de'i thugs dkar hūm̐ mthing nag /bdag thugs byin gyis brlab pa'o/ /sku yi yi ge oṃ las ni/ /'od zer ser po 'phros pa yis/ /sku yi lha rnams spyan drangs nas/ /mdzod spu'i 'jam dpal dag la thim/ /sku mi shigs rdo rje'i dbang thob gyur/ /gsung gi snying po āḥlas ni/ /'od zer dmar po 'phros pa yis/ /gsung gi lha rnams spyan drangs nas/ /mgrin pa'i rta mgrin dag la thim/ /gsung mi 'gag pa yi dbang thob gyur/ /thugs kyi snying po hūm̐ las ni/ /'od zer mthing nag 'phros pa yis/ /thugs kyi lha rnams spyan drangs nas/ /thugs ka'i phyag rdor dag la thim/ /thugs 'khrul pa med pa'i dbang thob gyur/ /yi ge gsum las 'od zer gsum/ /phyogs bcu rnams su 'phros pa yis/ /rigs bdag snang ba mtha' yas dang / /gzhan yang rigs lnga'i sangs rgyas dang / /sangs rgyas thams cad spyan drangs te/ /snang ba mtha' yas dag la thim/ /sku gsung thugs dang yon tan dang / /phrin las la sogs dbang thob gyur/ /de nas bdag gi thugs ka nas/ /rig pa'i ngo bo hūm̐ dmar las/ /'od zer nag po grangs med 'phros/ /hūm̐ nag grangs med 'jig rten khengs/ /snang srid thams cad gang bar gyur/ /hūm̐ rnams 'od du zhu ba las/ /khro bo yak+ṣa me dbal ni/ /dmar nag zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ /spyan gsum zhal gdangs mche ba gtsigs/ /g.yas pa rdo rje rtse lnga 'phyar/ /g.yon pa rdung ba'i tho ba rnams/ /sku la bskal pa'i me chen 'bar/

/de lta'i khro bos snang srid khengs/ /lha srin sde brgyad dregs pa'i tshogs/ /gnod byed gdon bgegs ma lus pa/ /'dar zhing dngangs nas brgyal dang 'bog /brdung zhing bsreg dang gsad par gyur/ /gu ru de wa ḍā ki nī sa pā ri wā ra ār+ghaṃ/ puṣ+pa/ dhū paṃ/ dī paṃ/ gan+dhaṃ/ nai wi d+yaṃ/ shap+taṃ pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ mahā pañtsa ya mṛ ta/ rak+ta pi ba tha āḥhūm̐/ /hūm̐ rang byung pad+ma thod phreng drag po'i sku/ /dregs pa lha srin sde brgyad 'dul mdzad cing / /'khor ba ma lus 'dren pa'i dpal gyur pa/ /gu ru drag po'i lha tshogs phyag 'tshal bstod/ /nad gdon bar chad mtha' dag zhi ba dang / /mchog dang thun mong dngos grub bstsal du gsol/ /rang gi snying khar nyi ma'i steng du hūm̐ dmar po'i mthar sngags kyis bskor ba las 'od 'phros/ /nad gdon sdig sgrib zhi bar byas/ /gu ru'i byin rlabs rang la zhugs par bsam/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ a tsig nir tsig na mo bha ga wa te hūm̐ hūm̐ āḥhūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa/ ci nus bzlas la/ /phyogs bcur bzhugs pa'i bla ma dang / /yi dam lha tshogs dgongs su gsol/ /dge ba 'di yis myur du bdag /pad+ma dbang drag 'grub gyur nas/ /'gro ba gcig kyang ma lus pa/ /de yi sa la 'god par shog sa skya lo tsā bas bris pa'o// //e waṃ// // PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 4 sa lo chen po 'jam dbyangs kun dga' bsod nams/ gu ru drag dmar gyi sgrub thabs/ PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 3
